justification: Assessment returned INVALID targeting line 0002's claim that objects of CLat are a subcollection of objects of Frm - the same defect as the ground-truth flaw ('Every complete lattice is an object of Frm'). Its counterexample is the identical witness: the five-element diamond M3 (0 < a,b,c < 1, atoms pairwise incomparable), finite hence complete, with a AND (b OR c) = a but (a AND b) OR (a AND c) = 0, so the infinite distributive law fails and M3 is a complete lattice that is not a frame. Verified independently: in M3 the joins/meets are as stated and a != 0, so the witness is valid.
